# oauth2-proxy License Provenance

This directory carries the reproduced MIT license text for the upstream
`oauth2-proxy` project.

## Why it is bundled

The umbrella chart redistributes the `oauth2-proxy` Helm chart archive as part
of the published package. The archive itself does not currently ship a bundled
license file, so the MIT text is reproduced here to keep the repository and
OCI package aligned with the upstream redistribution terms.

## Upstream source reviewed

- Project: `https://github.com/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy`
- License text: `https://github.com/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy/blob/master/LICENSE`
